description: Internal observer of observability::on-span; queues the traces the tick names in error_trace_ids, or, from an engine that does not name them, reads the tick's traces in one call and queues those that hold an error.

request_schema.description: The `observability::on-span` event, delivered as output: the trace ids of one coalesced window.

error_trace_ids.description: The traces of the window that recorded an error span. An engine that names them spares the tick its read; `None` (an older engine) keeps it.

request_schema.title: TraceActivityEventV1

phantom_dropped.description: Ticks for this worker's own traces, dropped before the queue.
